description: This file declares the SetupSource class, which is a task for setting up a media source element within a GStreamer-based media player. It includes class definition, constructor, destructor, and execute method, along with private members for context, player interface, and source element.

classes.name: SetupSource
classes.description: A class representing a task to set up a media source element in the GStreamer pipeline, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: SetupSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the setup source task with the given context, player interface, and source element.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set up the media source element.
